query: MATCH (c:Company) OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(:Tdoc)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c), (a)-[:RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO]->(ai:AgendaItem) WHERE ai.agendaNumber='7.1' OR ai.agendaNumber STARTS WITH '7.1.' RETURN c.companyName,count(DISTINCT a) AS contributionCount ORDER BY contributionCount DESC,c.companyName ASC LIMIT 10
